data.name: Manikram
data.gender_notes: Manikram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manikram is derived from Sanskrit words 'Mani' meaning jewel and 'Krama' meaning power. It is the name of a king in Hindu mythology who is known for his wealth and power. The name is often given to children born on a Tuesday and is considered lucky for those in creative fields. The name Manikram carries the meaning “Jewel (Mani) – Power (Krama)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manikram usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel (mani) – power (krama) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner wealth and power of an individual, inspiring them to use their gifts and abilities to create abundance in their lives.
data.etymology: Manikram belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel (Mani) – Power (Krama).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manikram total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
